tools.description: Track tasks for the current session. Use for multi-step work. Write the list as soon as the steps are known, then keep it current as work progresses: after each step finishes, mark it completed and the next one in_progress — never save updates for the end. `action: "write"` replaces the full list — include every item you want to keep. Inside a long-running `run_typescript` program, do the same through `tools.vibe.todo` so the list advances while the program runs.

action.title: Action

todos.description: Required when action='write': the full todo list, which replaces the previous one

tools.description:
Read and write files in your scratchpad: a private, per-session directory for working notes, findings, and fetched data.

Use it for anything you will need later in a long task. Files kept here outlive the messages that produced them: after the conversation is summarised, list and read them back to recover what you saved.

Paths are relative to the scratchpad directory; nested paths such as 'research/api-notes.md' are fine. A write replaces the file's whole contents. Do not use this for files that belong to the user's project -- use the filesystem tools for those.

action.description: Required on every call: 'write' to save a file, 'read' to fetch one back, or 'list' to see what the scratchpad holds
action.title: Action

content.description: Required for 'write': the file's full new contents
content.title: Content

path.description: Required for 'read' and 'write': a path relative to the scratchpad directory, for example 'findings.md'
path.title: Path

tools.description: Search structured finance and market data. Use for stock prices, market data, company metrics, financial statements, revenue, ARR, and finance time-series questions where the agent needs raw data instead of a synthesized web answer. Returns a `description` and `content`; `content` contains a structured payload whose fields vary by result type and query intent.

query.description: Natural-language finance data question. Include the relevant company or ticker, metric, and time period when known. Write the query in English.

tools.name: finance_search

end_date.description: The end date for the search (inclusive). Format: YYYY-MM-DD. If no date is specified, defaults to today's date.

query.description: Query to search for in news articles. Use keywords and specific terms for better results.

start_date.description: The start date for the search (inclusive). Format: YYYY-MM-DD. If no date is specified, defaults to 7 days before today.

url.description: The URL to open. Can be a full URL (https://...) or a news article ID (AFP/AP).

tools.description: Search structured weather data. Use for current weather, forecasts, historical or average weather, and weather time-series questions where the agent needs raw data instead of a synthesized web answer. Returns a `description` and `content`; `content` contains a structured payload whose fields vary by result type and query intent. By default, verbose hourly data is omitted; set `includeHourlyData` to true only for hour-by-hour weather questions. Include the country in location queries, or the state for US locations.

includeHourlyData.description: Include verbose hourly weather data. Defaults to false to keep weather results compact; set to true for hour-by-hour questions such as whether it will rain in the next few hours.

query.description: Natural-language weather data question. Include the relevant location, country, and time period when known. For US locations, include the state. Write the query in English.

tools.name: weather_search

end_date.description: Filter results older than this date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

start_date.description: Filter results newer than this date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
